import pandas as pd

def clean(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Standardize island names: strip whitespace and fix known variants
    island_map = {
        "Dream ": "Dream",
        "Torgerson": "Torgersen",
        "Bisco": "Biscoe"
    }
    df["island"] = df["island"].astype(str).str.strip()
    df["island"] = df["island"].replace(island_map)

    # Standardize sex values: lower‑case and map variants
    sex_map = {"FEMALE": "female", "female": "female", "male": "male"}
    df["sex"] = df["sex"].astype(str).str.lower().replace(sex_map)

    # Convert body_mass_g from text (with commas) to numeric
    df["body_mass_g"] = (
        df["body_mass_g"].astype(str)
        .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
        .astype(float)
    )

    # Ensure flipper_length_mm is numeric (some rows may be strings)
    df["flipper_length_mm"] = pd.to_numeric(df["flipper_length_mm"], errors="coerce")

    return df

def answer(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    # Count penguins per island after cleaning
    counts = df["island"].value_counts().to_dict()
    return counts
